subject.title: Add high-contrast mode for inactive displays

question: Should CodexBar permanently expose a persisted opt-in setting for higher-contrast Icon & percent rendering on inactive displays?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the behavior, but accepting another user-facing preference and alternate renderer is a product-maintenance choice that an external contributor cannot settle.

options.title: Approve the opt-in setting
options.body: Accept the narrowly scoped, default-off preference because it materially improves multi-display readability without changing existing behavior.

options.title: Decline the settings surface
options.body: Keep the native renderer only and close the linked request if the additional preference and alternate rendering path are not worth permanent support.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in setting
recommendation.body: Accept the narrowly scoped, default-off preference because it materially improves multi-display readability without changing existing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the best available decision owner for accepting a permanent settings and rendering surface.
